title: Recto: P19.66-T nat'l debt not alarming, PH better off than most nations

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Executive Secretary Ralph Recto on Tuesday said that the Philippines’ P19.66 trillion debt is not alarming, citing unexpected international tensions and corruption reforms as reasons for the country’s economic shortfall. Recto added that the Philippines is “better off than many, many other countries,” so there is no need for new taxes or for Filipinos to contribute to pay off the national debt. “Hindi naman [alarming]. Saka nadaanan na natin ‘to nung nakaraan. We know how to get out of this problem as well,” Recto said in an interview at the Senate when asked if the national debt is […]...
